english.title: Person under 18 knowingly consume alcohol on relevant premises
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being an individual under the age of 18, namely **(..SPECIFY THE AGE..) knowingly consumed alcohol, namely, **(..SPECIFY THE ALCOHOL..) on relevant premises, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PREMISES..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 150(1) and (5)(a) of the Licensing Act 2003.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being an individual under the age of 18 knowingly consumed alcohol on relevant premises

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
This issue of Penalty Notices for Disorder for this offence discontinued from 08/04/2013.

(i) Section 150(4) of the Licensing Act 2003 provides that the above offence does not apply where:-
(a) the individual is aged 16 or 17,
(b) the alcohol is beer, wine or cider,
(c) its consumption is at a table meal on relevant premises, and (d) the individual is accompanied at the meal by an individual aged 18 or over.
(ii) Fingerprints, photographs and DNA samples may be taken from an individual where he/she is subject to arrest and the Penalty Notice is issued at a police station.
